newsitem.title: UK: Johnson Matthey gets U.S. drug approval.
newsitem.headline: Johnson Matthey gets U.S. drug approval.

text.p: British metals and industrial materials group Johnson Matthey Plc said on Thursday its U.S. Biomedical Materials business had received manufacturing registrations from the U.S. Drug Enforcement Adminstration for a range of controlled drug active ingredients.

Johnson Matthey said the products included dihydrocodeine, diphenoxylate, hydrocodone, levorphanol, methadone, oxycodone, oxymorphone and thebaine. The company said they were used primarily for pain management.
Johnson Matthey said the total available market for the products in the U.S. was worth around $70 million per annum.
Johnson Matthey's Biomedicals Materials business is located in West Deptford, New Jersey.
